notes.title: New Player Protection and Hint
notes.notes:
There are several improvements on the very first dungeon for starters:
1, HP will be set to full when lower than 40%
2, The moon attacks are set to 100 second instead of 45
3, An "F2=Quick Save" Hint will show up before entering the first dungeon
In a word: You will be highly unlikely to be defeated in your first battle!

notes.title: Map Bug Fixed
notes.notes:
Bug Fixed:
1, A bug is causing the game to be unable to complete when reaching 100% game progress.
2, A bug prevents the player from completing the "Arcane Virtuoso" achievement.
3, When initiating a battle with the player, some monsters move slowly.
